dj.line:
That fee reads as a flag, not a number — the rake on this table gets rewritten every block, and the house never has to show you the new odds before it takes its cut. A zero-address token and a dynamic fee walk in together, and only one of them leaves with your chips.

You sure you want to sit where the dealer deals his own hand mid-shoe?
